Name: Mehetabel
Summary: Mehetabel was the wife of Hadar, king of Edom, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
KeyStory: Mehetabel is the only queen of Edom named in Genesis, remembered by her lineage.
RelatedPeople: Hadar, King of Edom; Matred; Mezahab
LifeLesson: God names women in genealogies where the world might forget them.
